_readme: One entry per template. 'fields' lists every id the generation engine should treat as a data-binding target — i.e. text to replace or an image to inject. Purely decorative/structural ids (gradients, clip-paths, corner ornaments, wrapper groups, static design labels) are intentionally excluded; the SVGs contain many more ids than are listed here, and that's expected. type 'text' = replace element's text content. type 'image' = set the element's image href to the uploaded file, scaled to fit its bounding box. 'image_target_id' (new): when an image field's id sits on a wrapping <g> rather than directly on the <image> element that carries the href, this names the actual <image> id to write to — render.js falls back to field.id when this is absent. 'reposition_sibling_if_empty' (new): { "id": "<element-id>", "transform": "<svg transform>" } — when this field is left blank, applies that transform to the named sibling element (e.g. sliding a lone remaining signature block to center once its counterpart's hide_container has removed it). required=false fields may be left blank/skipped per FR-2.7 (optional fields render blank, template layout never shifts).

templates.name: Exclusive Completion
templates.notes: FIX (Aug 2026): opt-seal-slot declares hide_container: 'seal-block' — the seal artwork is wrapped in <g id="seal-block">, confirmed present. FIX (Sep 2026): the 'Presented this Day day of Month, Year' line, the course-title line, and the program-dates paragraph were all left-anchored in an earlier revision to work around a suspected renderer bug — confirmed against real production output that centered text with inline styled tspans renders correctly, so all three were restored to centered. Also FIX: award-year previously had a hardcoded '20' prefix (Presented this Day day of Month, 20YY) which combined with a full 4-digit year typed by the user to read '202026' — award-year now expects and holds the complete year.

templates.name: Modern Excellence
templates.notes: No course-title or start-date/end-date fields by design — treated as a general achievement award, not tied to a specific course or date range. FIX (Aug 2026): opt-seal-slot declares hide_container: 'seal-block', confirmed present. FIX (Sep 2026): the 'Presented this Day day of Month, Year' line was left-anchored to work around a suspected renderer bug — confirmed against real production output that centered text with inline styled tspans renders correctly, so it was restored to centered. Also FIX: award-year previously had a hardcoded '20' prefix, same issue and same fix as Exclusive Completion.

templates.name: Premium Training
templates.notes: FIX (Aug 2026): award-date-line split into separate award-day/award-month/award-year fields; SVG's signature-1/signature-2/opt-seal-slot groups given real <image> elements so uploads and hide_container actually work. FIX (Sep 2026): logo-slot's identical missing-<image> bug fixed the same way — logo uploads now actually render. Granted line restored to centered (confirmed safe against real production output). NEW: signature-2 declares reposition_sibling_if_empty, sliding signature-1-block to the canvas's horizontal center (translate(1754,2245) — the block already carries its own translate transform, so this must be the full target position, not a delta) when only one signature is provided.

templates.name: Certificate of Excellence
templates.notes: Same as Modern Excellence — no course-title or date-range fields by design. FIX (Sep 2026): opt-seal-slot declares hide_container: 'seal-block' — the SVG already had that wrapping group around the decorative medallion, it just wasn't referenced here. Also FIX: the 'Presented this Day day of Month, Year' line was left-anchored to work around a suspected renderer bug — confirmed against real production output that centered text with inline styled tspans renders correctly, so it was restored to centered. NEW: signature-2 declares reposition_sibling_if_empty, sliding signature-1-block to the canvas's horizontal center (translate(304,0) — this block had no prior transform, so this is a pure offset, unlike Premium Training/Dulux Completion which needed the full target position) when only one signature is provided.

templates.name: Classic Completion
templates.notes: FIX (Sep 2026): both opt-logo-slot and opt-seal-slot had a real, working <image> element and wrapping decorative group already in the SVG — but the field id sat on the wrapping <g>, while the actual <image> carrying the href used a different id (logo-image / seal-image respectively). Uploads were silently being written to the group (no visual effect) instead of the image. Added image_target_id to point at the real image elements, and hide_container so the whole decorative frame (not just the image) disappears when nothing is uploaded, matching every other template's behavior.

templates.name: Dulux Completion
templates.notes: FIX (Sep 2026): logo-slot, signature-1, signature-2 and opt-seal-slot were all <g> groups containing only decorative artwork and placeholder text, with no actual <image> element at all — no institution had ever been able to get a logo or custom seal onto this template, and uploads had no element to write to. Real <image> elements were added, clipped to the existing circles, with wrapper groups renamed to logo-slot-block/signature-1-block/signature-2-block/seal-block. opt-seal-slot now declares hide_container: 'seal-block' to match. Also FIX: the program-dates paragraph's first line and the 'Granted this Day day of Month, Year' line were left-anchored to work around a suspected renderer bug — confirmed against real production output that centered text with inline styled tspans renders correctly, so both were restored to centered. NEW: signature-2 declares reposition_sibling_if_empty, sliding signature-1-block to the canvas's horizontal center (translate(1754,2245) — full target position, same reasoning as Premium Training, since this block also already carries its own translate transform) when only one signature is provided.

templates.name: Global Spec
templates.notes: FIX (Sep 2026): text-anchor="middle" paragraphs with inline styled tspans (program-dates line, granted line) were left-anchored in an earlier revision to work around a suspected renderer bug — confirmed against real production output that centered text with inline styled tspans renders correctly, so both lines were restored to centered. Also FIX: award-year previously had a hardcoded '20' prefix (Granted this Day day of Month, 20YY) which combined with a full 4-digit year typed by the user to read '202026' — award-year now expects and holds the complete year. Also FIX: opt-seal-slot now declares hide_container: 'seal-block' (the SVG's wrapping group already existed) so the seal medallion disappears entirely when unused, matching every other template.
